answer: Give every agent one onyx identity card, minted only after it finishes a 48-hour verifiable delay chain. Step one, the agent registers a hardware key. Step two, it crunches a sequential puzzle that no server farm can parallelize. Step three, peers verify the chain and stamp the card. Step four, any duplicate triggers a slash of its deposit. Forging 10,000 fake identities then burns $480,000 in hardware time and 48,000 machine-days, while one honest agent pays nothing but patience. A sybil swarm is a copper coin trying to echo through a vault door: noisy, cheap, and stopped cold. - Jowy
